faqs.a: No. The 60-day challenge is free for every Indian college student. You need a GitHub account and a LinkedIn profile, both free.

faqs.q: How much time does a day take?
faqs.a: Most days are 45 to 75 minutes. Week-end ship days are longer. Tasks are sized for a student who already had a full day of college.

faqs.q: What if I miss a day?
faqs.a: Your streak resets, but you are not out. Every 15 days you earn a Streak Shield that lets you repair one missed day within 48 hours by shipping the catch-up proof.

faqs.q: Do I need to be good already?
faqs.a: Day 1 is creating a public repository. If you can do that, you can start. Difficulty ramps across nine weeks.
The commit proves you built it. The post is what a recruiter actually finds. Sixty posts is a visible track record that a resume cannot fake.

faqs.q: What do I have at the end?
faqs.a: Sixty public commits, sixty posts, a deployed capstone project, and a portfolio arranged for recruiters.
